note: Documented post-storm riverfront / Warehouse District fires. Wikipedia: structure fire at 329 Tchoupitoulas St photographed the morning of 2 Sep 2005. NOFD/hazmat also fought the Mandeville Street Wharf warehouse fire and a fire at 3200 Chartres St. These are point sites, not a mapped burn scar.
